'''Rich Smith''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2000 Michigan tournament]] on 14 June 2000 with Forfiet Scrubs (Cloud City sites), according to Jason Aubry's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d893">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-14-wizards-of-the-coast-michigan-6-14-00d893/ wizards-of-the-coast-michigan-6-14-00], DeckTech (Jason "TrenchRunner" Aubry, 14 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-14-wizards-of-the-coast-michigan-6-14-00d893/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
